name: io.github.tonyyang0504/nettiauto-mcp
description: Nettiauto (automotive): search_listings, get_listing. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NETTIAUTO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Nettix API client id (Alma Media grants API access to business customers on application); used with grant_type=client_credentials at https://auth.nettix.fi/oauth2/token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_NETTIAUTO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The client's secret. The 24-hour JWT it mints is sent as the X-Access-Token header.
